as_told.title: Congressman joins the pastors' meeting by phone

plain: In 2026, people from the intelligence world are said to be quietly gathering pastors and telling them to get their churches ready for news about UFOs. Michels says, in his own words, that they are "meeting with these pastors and religious leaders across the country and convening them and telling them to prepare their churches." A congressman named Eric Burlison tells it first-hand. He says the organisers "decided they were going to put together a group of pastors kind of slowly bring them into this conversation, see where they are". He says they invited him to the meeting, held at a rented holiday home, and that he "couldn't make it, but would be happy to be on a phone call." He is a direct witness to the invitation, though not to the meeting itself. If true, insiders would be preparing religious communities for something they expect to become public.
